newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER SHOWCASE-FEYENOORD V PSV EINDHOVEN - MATCH ANALYSIS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-FEYENOORD V PSV EINDHOVEN - MATCH ANALYSIS.

text.p: Following is an analysis of the strengths and weaknesses of Feyenoord Rotterdam and PSV Eindhoven who meet in the Dutch first division at the Feyenoord Stadium on Sunday (Kickoff 1330 GMT):

Playing style: A 4-4-2 formation, with midfielders on either side pushing forward to support the attack. Feyenoord have a physically strong team who work hard, but lack some creativity. Libero Ronald Koeman commands the defence while Jean-Paul van Gastel takes care of the midfield.
